admission: Support data of natlang-rl-broad-external-20261031-v2 and its held packets: SQLite databases (Spider, BIRD) and DataBench tables that the cases' db/table services open read-only and check by SHA-256. Not a task source by itself.
note: Path is the default compiled into the case services (NATLANG_RL_TASK_ASSETS overrides it); keep it while any of the three broad-external packets is in use.
